title: Does Cracking Your Knuckles Give You Arthritis?
summary: Many people were told that cracking knuckles wears out the joints. Studies comparing crackers and non-crackers found no link to arthritis.

beats.text: Your friend cracks their knuckles and you say it will give them arthritis. Myth or fact?
Between the bones of each finger joint is a thin layer of slippery fluid.
Pull the joint and the pressure changes. That is when the pop happens.
Time's up. Does cracking cause arthritis?
beats.reveal: Myth! Studies of people who crack and people who don't found no link to arthritis.

beats.text: Doctors compared regular crackers with non-crackers. Both groups had arthritis at similar rates.
One thing to remember. If a joint hurts or swells when it cracks, see a doctor.

visual.text: Painful or swollen joint? Get it checked.
